newsitem.title: USA: Bonneville leaves Wednesday power offers unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Bonneville leaves Wednesday power offers unchanged.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) left offers for next-day pre-scheduled power unchanged from the previous day, the agency said Tuesday.
BPA continued to offer 200 megawatts of peak firm power at $18.00 per megawatt hour (MWh) for Northwest deliveries and $20.00 for California-Oregon border (COB) sales.
BPA's Wednesday price for firm power during light load hours was unchanged at $9.00 for both the Northwest and COB.
BPA also left Wednesday prices for non-firm power during hours ending 0100-0500 and 2400 PDT at $9.00 per MWh. Non-firm power during hours ending 0600 and 2300 PDT was unchanged at $10.00.
